title: Macerich Reports Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Results
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Macerich's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
SANTA MONICA, Calif., Aug. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The Macerich Company (NYSE: MAC) has released its Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Results and Supplemental Information by posting it to the Investor Relations section of its website at[investing.macerich.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=yzd-70JZeTTNAaoTLHU3remRcGV6rv5iS-3Ac4-iZwzF9-5i2Y5dnSLH3hKPG7Ztrax9VJMj96KqRzT66NYo6aNnQFHZCqCl8ZNrd2__u_g=) .


As previously announced, management will hold a conference call at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time (5:00 p.m. Eastern Time) today, Tuesday, August 4, 2026, to discuss quarterly results. Participants may join the live webcast by accessing it at the webcast link below or in the Investor Relations section of the company’s website at[investing.macerich.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=yzd-70JZeTTNAaoTLHU3remRcGV6rv5iS-3Ac4-iZwx15ZcFT-4Scp_FYBTR1Tj6597TJnBm3xY77-Lbq7xI8vqzI3vFWbfVYiYaW_6MePw=) .

**About Macerich**


Macerich (NYSE: MAC) is a fully integrated, self-managed, self-administered real estate investment trust (REIT). As a leading owner, operator, and developer of high-quality retail real estate in densely populated and attractive U.S. markets, Macerich’s portfolio is concentrated in California, the Pacific Northwest, Phoenix/Scottsdale, and the Metro New York to Washington, D.C. corridor. Developing and managing properties that serve as community cornerstones, Macerich currently owns approximately 40 million square feet of real estate, consisting primarily of interests in 38 retail centers.


Macerich uses, and intends to continue to use, its Investor Relations website, which can be found at investing.macerich.com, as a means of disclosing material nonpublic information and for complying with its disclosure obligations under Regulation FD. Additional information about Macerich can be found through social media platforms such as LinkedIn. Reconciliations of non-GAAP financial measures, including NOI and FFO, to the most directly comparable GAAP measures are included in the earnings release and supplemental filed on Form 8-K with the SEC, which are posted on the Investor Relations website at[investing.macerich.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=yzd-70JZeTTNAaoTLHU3remRcGV6rv5iS-3Ac4-iZwwHa3jRkuuCar23ylerRk-cYyvevRggT25P16tycizKZANr8hzmYDVMzkoqE4du_RIbW9bBhqsdHmtrwj5oz1wfC-VGYpUrE1OjXtGHyS6EXrD4_EcqdwuCQD9HIWgAKV6ia4L74hCsK87uyXcLjoZIpJd9pyCUWnc8D8OgA2xrzs-sP-oe9kCj2B-g88JTkXG9gfivnDsat6K2jRSfPQLQy5s-i2I9z5WmQOWP2VaQsg==) .
